contentEn:
Planning a kitchen renovation in North Vancouver in 2026? Costs range from $18,000 for a minor cabinet refresh to $95,000 for a luxury custom build, with most homeowners spending between $32,000 and $55,000 on a mid-range full renovation. This guide uses real data from 50 completed North Vancouver kitchen projects by Reno Stars, completed between 2023 and 2026, so you know what your project will actually cost.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

What Drives Kitchen Renovation Cost in North Vancouver

Three factors determine your budget more than anything else: the scope of work, the materials selected, and the condition of your existing cabinetry and infrastructure. A North Vancouver kitchen built in the 1970s or 1980s often requires electrical upgrades to meet current code, particularly if you are adding island outlets, under-cabinet lighting, or upgrading to a gas range. This alone can add $2,500 to $8,000 to your project.

Site access also matters. North Vancouver neighbourhoods like Deep Cove, Blueridge, and the upper slopes often have narrow lane access or hillside properties where material delivery and waste removal require a crane or smaller load vehicles. Budget an additional $800 to $2,500 for logistics on challenging sites.

Kitchen Renovation Cost by Scope

Reno Stars tracks actual project costs across North Vancouver neighbourhoods including North Vancouver City, Deep Cove, Blueridge, and the District of North Vancouver. Here are the real ranges from 2026 data:

Renovation TypeLowMidHigh
Cabinet refacing only$18,000$24,000$32,000
Minor update (countertops, paint, hardware)$22,000$32,000$45,000
Full renovation (new cabinets, counters, flooring)$38,000$52,000$72,000
Luxury custom build$65,000$85,000$120,000+

These figures include labour, materials, permits, and disposal. They do not include appliances if you are supplying your own, which can add $5,000 to $20,000 depending on brand and features.

What Does a Mid-Range North Vancouver Kitchen Cost?

For most North Vancouver homeowners, a mid-range kitchen renovation falls between $38,000 and $55,000. A typical scope for this budget includes removing load-bearing walls if required, installing custom shaker or slab cabinets, quartz or granite countertops, LVP or tile flooring, updated electrical for code compliance, new plumbing fixtures, and professional painting.

One North Vancouver City project completed in 2025 illustrates this range: a 140-square-foot kitchen with new custom maple cabinets, quartz countertops, LVP flooring, and updated electrical came in at $48,500 including permit. Another in Blueridge with a larger island, gas cooktop upgrade, and custom hood fan reached $61,000.

Timeline for a North Vancouver Kitchen Renovation

A minor update takes 3 to 5 weeks. A full renovation typically requires 8 to 12 weeks from permit approval to final inspection. Luxury custom builds can extend to 16 to 24 weeks depending on complexity and material lead times. Custom cabinetry alone requires 6 to 10 weeks from template to install in most cases.

Permit timelines in the District of North Vancouver average 2 to 4 weeks for kitchen alteration permits. The City of North Vancouver is typically 2 to 3 weeks. Reno Stars handles permit applications as part of every full renovation contract.

North Vancouver Neighbourhoods We Serve

Reno Stars operates throughout North Vancouver including the City of North Vancouver, District of North Vancouver, Deep Cove, Blueridge, Lynnmour, Seymour, and the Indian Arm area. Each neighbourhood has distinct housing stock that affects renovation scope: 1970s and 1980s townhomes in central North Vancouver typically have simpler layouts than the custom homes in Blueridge and Deep Cove, which often require more structural assessment.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the average cost of a kitchen renovation in North Vancouver BC in 2026?

Based on 50 completed projects, the average mid-range kitchen renovation in North Vancouver costs between $38,000 and $55,000 in 2026. Minor updates start around $22,000 while luxury custom builds routinely exceed $80,000. Each project is unique and costs depend on scope, materials, and site conditions.

How long does a kitchen renovation take in North Vancouver?

A minor kitchen update takes 3 to 5 weeks. A full kitchen renovation typically requires 8 to 12 weeks from permit approval to final inspection. Custom builds with structural changes can take 16 to 24 weeks. Permit approval adds 2 to 4 weeks depending on the municipality and scope.

Do I need a permit for a kitchen renovation in North Vancouver?

Permits are required for any work that changes the structural, electrical, or plumbing systems, or that involves removing walls. Cosmetic updates like refacing cabinets, replacing countertops, and painting generally do not require a permit. Reno Stars manages all permit applications as part of its renovation service.

What is the most expensive part of a kitchen renovation?

Custom cabinetry typically represents 30 to 40 percent of a full kitchen renovation budget. Countertops are the second-largest line item at 15 to 25 percent. Electrical upgrades, plumbing modifications, and flooring each represent 8 to 15 percent depending on scope. Labour and permits make up the remainder.

Does Reno Stars offer free estimates in North Vancouver?

Yes. Reno Stars provides free, no-obligation quotes for all renovation projects in North Vancouver and across the Lower Mainland. Quotes are based on an in-home consultation and include a detailed scope of work, material options, and timeline.
